reviews.name: BethanyL
reviews.body: These have changed my skin for the better will repurchase

reviews.name: EMMA.P
reviews.body: These pads are very generous with thr liquid, they are not exfoliating whatsoever more of a liquid thirst quenching drink for your skin. Im.not sure if i would repurchase again fue to the shear liquid that glides onto your skin.

reviews.name: SK12x
reviews.body: I love these glow pads! They have so much product on them compared to other toning pads I have tried. They are really refreshing & definitely do leave your face glowing. These will continue to be a repurchase for me going forward now, along with most of the Anua products I have tried.

reviews.name: Mhairi
reviews.body: Love these pads, although the instructions for use are confusing as they say to leave on skin, but I'm assuming that's for targeted areas. I swipe the pad all over my face & my skin drinks it in

reviews.name: Rotu
reviews.body: The anua pdrn glow pads are lovely. I use then before applying makeup and leave on dor around 20 mins. It leaves make up application so easy. My skins looks so glowy

reviews.name: Amelia
reviews.body: I cannot compliment this product enough it’s incredible it’s gentle but does the job my 50 year old skin feels amazing

reviews.name: Jane A
reviews.body: These patch’s are great. Plenty of product so can move them to different areas after 5 minutes. Thought hydration effect would wear off within hours like many patch’s but have found regular use maintains long term hydration of fine lines.

reviews.name: N.elle
reviews.body: Already been through three of these toner pad tubs. So hydrating makes your skin feel amazing afterwards. Will often use at night instead of a mask or to prep my skin before make up.

reviews.name: Bexo
reviews.body: I wanted to love this but I could not use it with anything without experiencing pilling.

reviews.name: Danni
reviews.body: I love these pads. So soft on my skin and makes my face feel fresh & cleansed
